Accept phase, emission and scheduling deferrals. x64 is decremented during phase-3 progression gated by the animation query, not demonstrated as a per-frame duration. The default phase path remains nonterminal. Command consumption, conditional constructor selection, NULL-result handling and callback restoration are supported; random-distribution guarantees, alternate-constructor gameplay identity, audio interpretation and the script producer remain deferred. Accept collision/helper-predicate deferrals. The failed floor test invokes the supplied transition, narrowing older unread-helper rationales such as link:af767076-eefe-491c-9c9c-9b08e81e53aa. The supported-contact branch can additionally call Item_8026ADC0, so unconditional state retention is not established. Landing dispatch has multiple gates. State 4 supplies both state-0 and state-1 transition callbacks, so fact:126f3148-3868-41ec-a4f3-e8393e3bb3f3's origin list is incomplete. Full predicate meanings, teardown effects and initial-contact helper semantics remain deferred.

Accept acceleration, lifetime and engine-processing compound deferrals with the document's qualifications. Acceleration is gated, not clamped. The local lifetime callback subtracts before testing; the common animation dispatcher conditionally routes a true result to destruction. This narrows prior dispatcher uncertainty but does not prove exactly-once invocation or all runtime conditions. Common physics accepts NULL and performs other movement work, contradicting a required non-NULL physics slot or engine-wide inactivity inferred from an empty callback. The named Spawned hook always requests state 1, and expiration is a callback result rather than a demonstrated expiry state.

Accept the listed cleanup/event-provenance deferrals while explicitly narrowing their older unread-callee rationales. Both local two-object wrappers forward unchanged arguments, and it_8026B894 clears matching interaction references. Thus cleanup is supported for link:232c2b31-af13-48d2-8f27-97f5bde451e3, link:25f46ca0-0aac-4fc2-be77-91b575d50bcc, link:6cdda8f3-1a16-4f43-8702-442a5e500aeb and link:e8f3c529-78c7-45e0-9127-401f24c401eb; precise lifecycle triggers and complete registration claims are not thereby validated. The constructor preserves distinct owner and immediate-parent references, whose later cleanup must not be conflated with spawning.
